title: Professor Blake's library at Jenkins'
summary: A brass teacher from Jenkins' who had studied at Howard let him use his music books on Sundays.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Learning your horn: teachers, lessons and fees

blocks.x: And like I say, I used to go over to this guy's house and discuss music. And, then there was a professor of brass instruments at Jenkins. Professor Blake was his name. And, he -- we became good friends. I used to go up to his house. He was a graduate of Howard University. And, he was a tuba player, and we became friends, and I used to go up to his place. He had a place on the outskirts of town, a home up there. And, I used to go up there on Sundays, you know, and go through his library where his music books and what-not and had help me.
